events.brand: NYS Daniel’s Law Coalition × Assemblymember Catalina Cruz
events.what_it_is: A free community wellness and resource day connecting New Yorkers with healthcare and mental-health resources, housing and food assistance, employment and education opportunities, legal services, holistic wellness resources, and family activities.
events.what_is_free: Admission and the community resource programming are free and open to the public.
events.caveats: The event is explicitly described as free and open to the public. The host/partner page asks visitors to register, and the event listing publishes an RSVP link; no organizer-selection or approval step is established in the sources reviewed.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM–2 PM at PS 16Q. Use the playground entrance at 42nd Avenue and 104th Street. Open to residents from Queens and across all five boroughs.

occurrences.details: Free community wellness/resource event. RSVP/registration link is published; no approval step is established. Playground entrance at 42nd Avenue and 104th Street.
